authorization: root approved explicit D04 r05 edge convention before any filtering

joint_payload.encoding: UTF-8, no BOM, no trailing newline
joint_payload.bucket: unsigned integer of first16 hexadecimal digest characters modulo100

actor_cell.zero_actors: fixed actor_none_v1; no invented unused actor parameters; sentinel is not a mutable actor-policy ownership group
actor_cell.single_actor: actor_ plus first24 hexadecimal SHA256 of existing canonical sorted compact JSON cell with policy,speed_cell,response_distance_cell,margin_cell,delay_cell
actor_cell.multiple_actors: actor_tuple_v1_ plus full SHA256 of compact UTF-8 JSON ordered [[benchmark_actor_1,actual_cell_id], ...]; actor roles and ordering must match actual scene actor_geometry
actor_cell.multi_actor_atomic_cell_ownership: each constituent actor cell inherits one split; tuple hashing cannot bypass atomic ownership

parent_group_priority.existing_parent: preserve immutable prior split ownership; joint hash must agree with that split or combination is rejected; never relabel r04
parent_group_priority.near_duplicate: same owner as registered canonical group; D04 r05 rejects replacement candidates within frozen near-duplicate cells, plus retained two-cell development distinctness gate
parent_group_priority.new_parent: first eligible nonduplicate actual parent/cell joint hash assigns group owner; all future cells, rigid transforms and cosmetic variants must retain that owner
parent_group_priority.actor_cell: prior ownership is preserved; a new atomic cell obtains selected joint split once; conflicting ownership is rejected
parent_group_priority.all_selected_pairs: joint hash=development AND parent owner=development AND every actual atomic actor cell owner=development
parent_group_priority.forbidden: random split of episode rows; selecting another no-actor sentinel; relabelling a prior parent; moving a rejected combination to development

finite_input_enumeration.existing_candidates: existing r04 parents considered first, unchanged geometry
finite_input_enumeration.actor_cells: deterministic finite Cartesian product of actual frozen discrete parameter cells; policy role order cycles cautious/hesitant/assertive; no stochastic draw or new seed
finite_input_enumeration.counterexamples: retain all rejected joint payload/digest/bucket/ownership reasons; retain every failed geometry/raster/guide artifact and numeric gate; never overwrite r04

offline_gates.raster_export: frozen static_map_export.make_artifacts, static geometry only; no carving
offline_gates.shared_guide: frozen common_route.build_bundle clearance radius1.0; check resulting exact occupied/unknown pixel union against full conservative footprint, all segments and corner heading transitions
offline_gates.witness_after_raster: recheck native static witness against exact occupied/unknown raster union with original interval deduction; if negative, retain failure and seek another already declared finite witness profile, never reduce margin

outputs: 24 geometry/actual-cell combinations plus four static shared-map bundles and complete failure evidence; no ROS, execution seeds, new global registry or final outcomes
